exercises.name: Side Neck Stretch
steps: Keep your shoulders relaxed and tilt one ear gently toward the shoulder.
Don't pull on your head: its own weight is enough.
Breathe slowly and switch sides halfway through.

exercises.name: Chin to Chest Stretch
steps: Sit or stand tall, shoulders relaxed.
Lower your chin slowly toward your chest until you feel the back of the neck lengthen.
Breathe for 15 seconds, then lift your head back up slowly.

exercises.name: Looking at the Ceiling
steps: Stand tall with your hands resting on your lower back.
Lift your chin and look up slowly, as far as feels comfortable.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower your gaze back to the front.

exercises.name: Shoulder Circles
steps: Let your arms hang and your shoulders relax, sitting or standing.
Roll your shoulders forward, up, back and down, slowly.
Reverse the direction halfway through, without forcing.

exercises.name: Shoulder Shrugs
steps: Let your arms hang by your sides.
Lift your shoulders toward your ears as you breathe in.
Let them drop softly as you breathe out.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
steps: Stand with your arms stretched out to the sides at shoulder height.
Draw small, slow circles, then reverse the direction.
Breathe normally and keep your shoulders low.

exercises.name: Elbow Circles
steps: Place your fingertips on your shoulders, elbows at shoulder height.
Draw small, slow circles with your elbows.
Breathe out as you open and in as you close. Keep the movement smooth.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
steps: Bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Hold it just above the elbow with the other hand and pull gently toward you.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathing, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Triceps Stretch
steps: Put one hand behind your head, elbow pointing to the ceiling.
Hold that elbow with the other hand and pull very gently.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch arms.

exercises.name: Elbows Back
steps: Stand with your hands on your lower back and elbows out to the sides.
Gently bring your elbows back, without forcing.
Breathe slowly and release before any discomfort in your chest.

exercises.name: Arm Against the Wall
steps: Stand with one forearm bent against a wall or a door frame.
Lean gently toward that arm until you feel a light stretch along the side.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch arms.

exercises.name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
steps: Stand tall with your arms stretched forward at shoulder height.
Open your arms out to the sides and back, as far as is comfortable, then bring them forward again.
Move slowly with the breath: in as you open, out as you close.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Stretch
steps: Sit tall on a chair and interlace your fingers.
Turn your palms to the ceiling and reach up, shoulders down.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds and release.

exercises.name: Reach for the Ceiling
steps: Stand tall with your hands together above your head.
Grow gently upward without arching your back.
Breathe slowly and come back down smoothly.

exercises.name: Standing Side Bend
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and one arm reaching overhead.
Lean slowly to the opposite side, lengthening the whole side of the body.
Hold for 15 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Seated Spinal Twist
steps: Sit tall on a chair, feet flat, and hold the back of the seat or the backrest.
Turn your chest slowly to one side, keeping both hips on the chair.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathing slowly, then turn to the other side.

exercises.name: Seated Lower Back Stretch
steps: Sit on a chair with your feet flat, knees apart.
Let your head and chest fold forward between your knees, arms hanging.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds, then roll back up one vertebra at a time.

exercises.name: Middle Back Stretch
steps: Sit or stand and clasp your hands in front of you at chest height.
Round the upper back and push the hands away until you feel the area between the shoulder blades.
Breathe slowly for 15 seconds, then release.

exercises.name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft.
Tilt your pelvis forward and back, slowly.
Look for a long, relaxed back and breathe calmly.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles
steps: Sit or stand with your arms in front of you and your wrists loose.
Draw small circles with your wrists.
Reverse the direction halfway through.

exercises.name: Side Wrist Pull
steps: Stand tall and clasp one wrist with the other hand in front of you.
Gently pull that wrist across and down to the side, lengthening the arm and the side of the neck.
Hold for 15 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Stand with one foot in front of the other, knees soft.
Gently push your pelvis forward, keeping your back straight.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch, Hands on the Wall
steps: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands on it, one foot back with the heel down.
Keep the back leg straight and press the heel into the floor.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
steps: Stand holding on to something solid.
Lift one foot and draw a big circle with your big toe.
Reverse the direction, then switch feet.

exercises.name: Upper Back Stretch
steps: Hold your hands together in front of you and round your upper back.
Let your head drop forward and reach your hands away from you.
Breathe into the upper back for 15 seconds, then release.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Stretch
steps: Stand facing a wall, one foot back with the heel on the floor and the leg straight.
Lean forward until you feel the back calf stretch.
Hold for 15 seconds, breathe, switch legs.

exercises.name: Interlaced Overhead Stretch
steps: Stand with your fingers interlaced and your palms facing the ceiling.
Stretch your arms up, shoulders down, without arching.
Breathe slowly and release before any discomfort.

exercises.name: Dynamic Back Stretch
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging loosely.
Swing the arms gently across the chest and back out again, turning the upper body a little.
Keep the movement small and smooth, and breathe normally.
